a:r.a:t: Engagement flow: example activities for a Proof of Concept
Frontier accelerate for copilot: Envisioning & POC
Below is an example order of activities to be delivered from
Assess > Inspire > Design > Proof of Concept.
This proof-of-concept example is designed to help drive early usage of Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents and increase customer intent for purchasing additional licensing.
Assess
Define success
Inspire
Deliver product overviews and demos
Deliver security & governance overview
Deliver adoption and change management overview
Deliver reporting & analytics overview
Design
Define technical/functional requirements for agents
Build an adoption roadmap
Define success criteria for a POC
Prepare environment for proof of concept
Proof of Concept
Define the scope of the proof of concept
Request and enable trial licenses
Build a proof-of-concept agent(s) or solution(s), and enable key features
Provide training to proof-of-concept users
Measure and evaluate proof of concept results
Deliver executive summary, including recommendations on next steps, risks, owners, and estimated completion dates
